Every frame the checks looked at

120 frames across the whole take, each frozen and checked on its own. Allegro and LEAP: no little finger, so the person's little-finger contact is left out. Red means not by this method at this pose, not that the hand can never do the task.
Green in the turning check is a low bar: the turn itself needs little torque, median 0.20 mN m, and the model sets no limit on end-stop load. Built for this film, not the banked method.
